accommodation: 10 en-suite bedrooms: doubles, twins and singles
suitableFor: Couples, solo travellers and small groups who want a pub base
beachAccess: About 200 yards from Summerleaze beach and the sea lock (official site)

overview: The Brendon Arms is a free-house pub overlooking Bude's inner harbour, with ten en-suite rooms above the bar. Summerleaze beach and the sea lock are about 200 yards away, and the pub serves home-made food and Cornish and national ales.
surfTripFit: Being a couple of hundred yards from Summerleaze makes it an easy walk to the surf, though there is no mention of board storage or parking.
gaps: Parking, dog policy in rooms, board storage and Wi-Fi not stated.
